# thenervelab/homebrew-tap

> The Homebrew tap that installs `hipc`. That CLI is deprecated. Do not tap this to store files or to run a miner.

Part of the Hippius docs for agents. Start at https://docs.hippius.com/llms.txt

## What it is and what it does

`brew tap thenervelab/tap` then `brew install hipc` is the install path in this repo's README. `hipc` targeted the retired IPFS network. The formula is not a working install of a current Hippius client.

https://docs.hippius.com/cli/usage

## How to install

Do not.

## What to use instead

| Job | Use |
|---|---|
| Store or fetch files | An S3 client. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thenervelab/hippius-s3/staging/llms.txt |
| Models and containers | `pip install hippius_hub`. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thenervelab/hippius-hub/main/llms.txt |
| Desktop sync | https://hippius.com/desktop-app |
| Run a miner | https://docs.hippius.com/earn/arion/running-miner |

## Links

- Documentation home: https://docs.hippius.com
- Deprecation notice: https://docs.hippius.com/cli/usage
- This repository's README (the old install): https://github.com/thenervelab/homebrew-tap/blob/main/README.md
